claim_scope: An exact mm0-hs source revision was built with its locked GHC 8.6.5/LTS 13.27 environment through a locally qualified x86_64 matching runner. It rejected raw set.mm@160ebb at a modern $j comment string, but accepted a six-line $j color-metadata compatibility derivative. The derivative was accepted by the exact Metamath verifier, fully translated to MM0/MMB, and its MMB was accepted by mm0-c.

matching_runner.host: macOS 27.0 arm64 with Rosetta x86_64 execution

raw_input_control.scope: The exact current raw source uses double-quoted varcolorcode metadata in six $j comments, which this pinned parser does not accept. This is a direct-input compatibility failure, not a failure of the Metamath proof database or a ZFC claim.

comment_normalized_control.transformation: Six double-quoted strings in $j varcolorcode/altvarcolorcode metadata were rewritten to the single-quoted syntax parsed by MM0.FromMM. No $c/$v/$f/$e/$a/$p formal token was intentionally edited.

metamath_verifier.result: 252401 statements; 3072 $a; 47917 $p; all proofs verified in 8.60 s.

translation.command: arch -x86_64 mm0-hs from-mm <comment-normalized set.mm> -o set.mm0 set.mmb

separate_reference_mmb_verification.verifier: mm0-c built from mm0-c/main.c in the same fixed MM0 source; separate from mm0-hs translator code, not an organizationally independent implementation

raw_text_preservation.reason: These are verbatim terminal captures. They retain terminal-emitted trailing whitespace and are intentionally excluded from git diff --check; their SHA-256 identities are recorded above or in source-manifest.json.

non_goals: No exact raw-byte set.mm@160ebb direct from-mm output: the pinned parser rejects its six modern $j metadata strings.

No target-specific diagonal sentence, no InternalProvabilityAdequacy, and no claim about bare ZFC inconsistency or incompleteness.
